components.css: .ds-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .ds-heading-bar { width: 4px; height: 24px; background: var(--red, #E10600); border-radius: 2px; } .ds-heading-title { font-family: var(--display, 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif); font-weight: 400; font-size: 26px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text, #E8EBEF); margin: 0; } .ds-heading-badge { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted, #A3ABB6); background: var(--bg-elevated, #1E2025); border: 1px solid var(--border, #2A2D34); padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-heading-link { margin-left: auto; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-muted, #A3ABB6); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--border-strong, #343842); text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-heading-link:hover { color: var(--text, #E8EBEF); text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-heading-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #FFC940); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ranked Row
components.description: Timing-tower row for standings and results, with a team-colour left edge.
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 24px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--bg-elevated, #1E2025); border: 1px solid var(--border, #2A2D34); border-left: 3px solid var(--team); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--text, #E8EBEF); font-family: var(--body, Archivo, sans-serif); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease; } .ds-row:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong, #343842); border-left-color: var(--team); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #FFC940); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-row-pos { font-family: var(--display, 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif); font-size: 22px; line-height: 1; color: var(--text-muted, #A3ABB6); text-align: center; } .ds-row-main { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; } .ds-row-name { font-family: var(--display, 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif); font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; line-height: 1; } .ds-row-bar { display: block; height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--border, #2A2D34); overflow: hidden; } .ds-row-fill { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--team); } .ds-row-sub { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted, #A3ABB6); } .ds-row-fig { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; } .ds-row-value { font-family: var(--display, 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif); font-size: 24px; line-height: 1; } .ds-row-unit { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted, #A3ABB6); }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--body, Archivo, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-muted, #A3ABB6); text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-pill:hover { color: var(--text, #E8EBEF); background: var(--bg-elevated, #1E2025); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #FFC940); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pill-active, .ds-pill-active:hover { color: var(--text, #E8EBEF); background: var(--pill-active, #262A31); font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
The strategists' wall of timing screens: dark, dense, and calm under pressure. Everything sits in near-black graphite layers so the information carries the colour: a team's livery on the edge of its row, amber on whatever comes next, red only to sign the page. Numbers are set big in a condensed display face and read first; prose is short and secondary.

Components are precise and quiet. Surfaces are flat, borders are hairlines, and hover is a small shift in tone, not a lift. The display face (Bebas Neue) gives the race-poster energy; Archivo, squeezed on its width axis for the hero race name and countdown, adds speed without decoration. Density follows the job: Home's hero breathes, while the standings, results and telemetry views pack rows tightly for scanning.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black tonal layering instead of shadows.
Team colour as a 3px edge (left on rows, top on cards and podium steps), always from the API.
Condensed display type for positions, names, points and countdown digits; tabular numerals everywhere.
One amber accent for "next" states and the focus ring; red only for heading bars and the logo badge.
44px minimum hit targets on every control.

rules.name: The Livery Rule
rules.body: Team colour is data, never decoration. It comes from the API (`teamColor` / `color`), is never hardcoded in the frontend, and appears as a 3px edge or a fill tied to that team's own row, card or chart series.

rules.name: The One Next Rule
rules.body: Safety Amber marks exactly one thing per view as "next" (plus the focus ring). If two things are amber, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Dim-by-Colour Rule
rules.body: De-emphasise with Telemetry Grey, not `opacity`, so dimmed text keeps its contrast.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: `tabular-nums` is global; numbers never jitter as they update.

rules.name: The Numbers-in-Display Rule
rules.body: A position, points total or countdown is set in the display face (Bebas Neue, or condensed Archivo 800). Its unit ("pts", "days") drops to body size in Telemetry Grey.

rules.name: The Flat-Wall Rule
rules.body: Hover and selection change tone or border, never lift. If something needs to feel raised, move it one step up the tonal ladder.

dos: Do take team colours from the API and use them as 3px edges, bars or chart series for that team's own data.
Do set positions, points and countdowns in Bebas Neue or condensed Archivo 800, with units at 12px in Telemetry Grey.
Do keep every interactive element at least 44px tall (tabs inside panels: 36px).
Do show missing data as a calm notice in Telemetry Grey (`ErrorMsg`'s "Not available yet"), not a red error box.
Do build new components as CSS Modules using the `:root` tokens.
donts: Don't use Start-Light Red for anything but heading bars, the logo badge and the analyst slider.
Don't use Safety Amber for anything but "next" and focus.
Don't dim with `opacity`; use Telemetry Grey.
Don't add box shadows to surfaces; step up the tonal ladder instead.
Don't hardcode a team colour in React.
Don't use official Formula 1 logos, wordmarks or marks; the product is an unofficial fan project.
